description: Take a match off the venue call screen (needs manage_code). With a court, only that court's screen is cleared and the other courts keep showing their matches; without a court, EVERY court's screen is cleared at once. A cleared screen falls back to the console calling queue board, or to the standby face when the queue is empty. Safe to call when nothing is on screen — it simply reports that. Does not touch the calling queue.

court.description: Optional: clear only this court's screen. Omit to clear every screen at once.

name: screen_clear
